why: H-6K flight deck: a solid radome nose and a flight deck set back under a stepped, raised windscreen of flat panes (the Tu-16 family uses flat armoured glass: a centre post between two front panes either side, then side windows). The model's own window band is the frame layout (canopy_h_6k.py): per side a front pane and a quarter pane either side of the centre / corner posts and two side panes before and behind a side post, each one exact plane (the best fit through its frame corners). The pane count and sizes are the model's line, UNVERIFIED against photographs of the real H-6K. The roof is metal and closed: no overhead panes.
